messages:
alex: Heads-up — Sprinter (HW partner) asked us to run a joint smoke bench next week. They care most about perf/W, sustained throughput, and kernel-level probe points for cache/threads. Can we quickly lock scope + owners? cc @maria @jin :eyes:
maria: I can own infra and telemetry. plan: 1) smoke runs (3 configs) 2) detailed kernel traces (one config) 3) perf/W sweep. Need partner VPN creds and rack reservation.
jin: I'll take kernel probe work. questions: do we want INT8 vs FP16 comparison in the smoke or separate follow-up? quantization changes the kernel path so would bias perf/W.
olivia: For smoke, propose these inputs: batch sizes [1,4,8], seq len [64,256], and two models (gpt-small-open, gpt-medium-open). Keep single-replica to isolate hw.
alex: good. jin + maria: timeline? partner prefers results by EOW next Fri (their marketing window). can we hit that?
maria: EOW is tight but doable for smoke + one kernel trace. I need Sprinter VPN + runner images by Tue. I'll start infra today: reserving 2xA100-equivalent nodes, isolated VLAN.
jin: I'll prepare probe scripts. need to confirm which kernels to instrument: attention, matmul, softmax, kv-cache memcpy. also want pmu counters for L2_misses, cycles.
samir: I'll coordinate partner comms and marketplace spec alignment. also want a short blurb for joint announcement if results are clean. We should agree on embargo + sign-off workflow.
bench-bot: scheduled job created: job_id=sb-2026-03-17-09, dashboard: https://benchboard.redwood/sb-2026-03-17-09 :rocket:
bench-bot: initial smoke config queued:
```
./run_bench --model gpt-medium-open --batch 4 --seq 128 --mode smoke --profile watt --out sb-2026-03-17-09
```
olivia: quick note on success criteria: perf/W improvement >= 1.2x over baseline OR latency within 10% of host target at p99. We'll flag regressions in the dashboard.
ajex: (typo) meant alex — :facepalm: :thumbsup:
maria: vpn creds requested from Sprinter. pinged partner contact Clara. Also adding an eval set for representative prompts.
jin: I'll add kernel trace wrapper (uses `perf record -e cycles,L2_rqsts.all_miss -o trace.data`) and a small postprocess to map hotspots to ops.
alex: excellent. owners recap: infra/telemetry = maria, kernel probes = jin, partner comms = samir, harness/testcases = olivia, overall lead = alex.
samir: I'll draft a 1-pager for partner: goals, scope, timeline, sign-offs, and a 2-slide marketing teaser. will share here by EOD.
maria: infra note: if partner images differ, we'll run containerized shim. need kernel headers on nodes for perf.
jin: one more: please confirm whether we can use the dedicated KV cache snapshot from Sprinter or need to generate locally. snapshot affects warm-start throughput.
alex: ping Clara for KV snapshot. also please put any sensitive links in the private partner doc (not in slack).
bench-bot: smoke run completed (partial). results snippet:
```
config,batch,seq,throughput,tokens_per_joule,p99_ms
baseline,1,64,320 req/s,0.45 tok/J,120 ms
sprinter-opt,1,64,380 req/s,0.58 tok/J,115 ms
```
link: https://benchboard.redwood/runs/sb-2026-03-17-09/results
olivia: Nice uplift on tokens/J. Can you export the raw traces for jin?
maria: exporting now to s3://redwood-partner/sprinter/sb-2026-03-17-09/trace.tar.gz and shared with Clara.
jin: got it, starting analysis. will post a short heatmap of kernel hotspots in next update.
alex: great progress. next sync Tue 10am PT with Sprinter and infra leads. agenda: confirm VPN, hand off traces, review smoke charts, agree follow-ups. I'll send invite. :calendar:
